questions.question: Near the end of his life in Egypt, what did Jacob ask his son Joseph to promise about his burial?

answers.text: Bury him with his fathers outside Egypt
Bury him in Goshen among his people
Bury him wherever Joseph thinks is best

questions.question: What did Jacob say about Joseph's two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, who were born in Egypt?

answers.text: They will be counted as Jacob's own sons
They will serve their uncles in Canaan
They will stay behind in Pharaoh's house

questions.question: When old Jacob blessed Joseph's sons, the firstborn Manasseh stood at his right hand. What did Jacob do?

answers.text: Crossed his hands and put his right on Ephraim
Put his right hand on Manasseh's head
Had Joseph swap the two boys around

questions.question: When Jacob blessed Joseph's sons, what did he say about the younger son Ephraim compared to Manasseh?

answers.text: He will be greater and his offspring will become many nations
He will serve Manasseh for the rest of his life
He will lead the whole family back to Canaan
